artists.name: KRISKO
artists.bio: One of the biggest names in Balkan hip-hop, Krisko brings chart-topping hits and a stage presence that turns any room into a sold-out arena. Expect an explosive set full of the anthems everyone knows word for word.

artists.name: DESSITA
artists.bio: Dessita's sound blends pop sensibility with unmistakable Balkan flavor. Her live shows are known for raw vocals and a connection with the crowd that makes every performance feel personal.

artists.name: ANDREA
artists.bio: A rising force in the scene, Andrea combines high-energy production with a magnetic stage presence. This is a set built for a crowd that wants to move all night long.
